spans.s:
A number.
E.
धू to agitate, affix लि.

f. (-का)
Fog or mist.
E.
धलि dust, कन् affix of resemblance; the dust of the atmosphere.

n. (-मं)
A mound, a rampart.
E.
धूलि dust or earth, and कुट्टिम prepared ground.

m. (-रः)
A mound, a rampart of earth.
E.
धूलि dust, and केदार a field.

m. (-कः)
The red vegetable powder thrown about at the spring festival called the Holī.
E.
धूलि dust, and गुच्छक a nosegay; also धूलिगुच्छ m. (-च्छः.)

m. (-जः)
Air or wind.
E.
धूलि dust, and ध्वज sign or symbol.

m. (-म्बः)
1 A species of the Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cordifolia.)
2 Tila, a plant.
3 A tree: see वरुण (Tapia cratæva.)
E.
धली dust, and वदम्ब Kadamba, whose pollen perhaps resembles that of the Kadamba, or having a similar [] quantity of blossoms; also with कन् added धूलीकदम्बक; these words are also written with a short इ, as धूलिकदम्बक.

m. (-लः)
A cloud of dust.
E.
धूली, and पटल a heap.
